notes: Live TV reconnects better: channels from Xtream logins now play as MPEG-TS by default (change it in Settings → Playback → Live stream format), a stream your provider closes comes straight back, and after a drop it keeps trying every couple of seconds until the provider lets go of the old connection. Films and series from addons: the stream you choose is the one that keeps playing, even when its link has to be refreshed, and the player shows where it comes from (the addon and debrid service, with more under Info). The stream list marks each debrid service and streams that aren't cached yet.
